newsitem.title: RUSSIA: No danger to 300 people trapped in Russian tunnel.
newsitem.headline: No danger to 300 people trapped in Russian tunnel.

text.p: About 300 people trapped by avalanches in a tunnel in the Caucasus mountains are in no danger, the Russian Emergencies Ministry said on Tuesday.
"Their evacuation is just a matter of time," a Moscow-based ministry spokesman said by telephone, adding rescue workers delivered fresh supplies to the trapped people on Monday.

Officials said on Monday it would take at least two more days to rescue the 300 people and their vehicles trapped since Thursday inside the four-km (2.5 mile) Roksky tunnel linking Russia's North Ossetia region with the breakaway Georgian province of South Ossetia.

Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday two women had given birth while trapped in the tunnel and one new-born child had died of the cold. Two other people were reported to have died in the area over the weekend.

Rescue teams and doctors, entering the tunnel on foot, have managed to deliver food, medicine and warm clothing. Some of the trapped motorists refused to leave the tunnel in case their cars were stolen or looted, Russian news agencies said.
